title: Protected Context Correction Sync Contract
principle: Correction trails for teams belong behind protected backend auth; the public frontend may only carry metadata and UI state.
public_repo_rule: No raw prompts, raw responses, provider secrets, API keys, chat transcripts, document text or paid route execution are stored in this public artifact.

sync_storage_boundary.public_frontend: Browser-local correction receipts and public-safe route contract evidence only.
sync_storage_boundary.protected_backend: Owner-scoped correction trails, undo state and hygiene suggestions behind protected auth.
sync_storage_boundary.future_team_scope: Organization-scoped review can build on the backend contract after RBAC and audit retention hardening.

routes.purpose: List metadata-only correction trails and hygiene suggestions for an authenticated workspace owner.
Sync correction events from public clients after rejecting raw prompt, response, transcript and secret fields.
Mark one owned correction event as undone without deleting the audit trail.

backend_checks.name: Managed API route manifest
backend_checks.evidence: Runtime Fastify routes and MANAGED_API_ROUTES.json matched.

backend_checks.name: JSON/OpenAPI validation
backend_checks.evidence: MANAGED_API_ROUTES.json, openapi.json, package files and node fixture JSON were valid.

scenarios.expected: The backend route manifest owns correction sync under protected-backend-auth, not public GitHub Pages.
The backend store accepts correction metadata but rejects raw prompts, raw responses, transcripts and secret-like fields.
Undo state is represented as metadata and marked undone while preserving the correction event.
Protected data export/import/delete includes context_corrections for owner-scoped workspace portability.

next.label: Protected correction sync UI handoff
next.reason: The backend contract exists; the next slice should let the public UI detect protected sync availability and hand off browser-local correction trails without exposing secrets.
